config.design: Prospective competence-only screen. New source vocabulary relative to all H882 discovery and research-transfer examples, two familiar and two new task/copy templates. No refit, selection or intervention outcomes. New relative to frozen-query experiment, not guaranteed unseen throughout the broader research history or pretraining. All failures retained.
config.gate: Per domain/family/format >=4 eligible pairs, both-endpoint binary accuracy>=.75 and pooled full-vocabulary top1>=.5. Require task and copy cells competent for confirmatory comparison. Pair exclusions only token/alignment validity; all4 formats required.
config.next: Evaluate every frozen H935 model on this frozen manifest, separately by format and competence; no tuning. Preserve natural full-distribution and donor-effect metrics. Any unseen end-distance uses zero predicted coefficient for every model, explicitly audited.
